supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Build arrays with physical objects and describe them in terms of multiplication. Describe an array as an arrangement of objects into rows with an equal number of objects in each row and into columns with an equal number in each column.
teachingSteps: Draw rows and columns with equal spacing.
Count rows and columns; relate the array to equal groups.
Compare rotated or reorganized arrays while preserving the total.
